xtmux-71y.description:
## PROBLEM

`xtmux topology --json` (xtrm.xtmux.topology.v1) exposes a per-pane `agent` object with
instance_id, state, bead_id, task, prompt_file, parent_session_id, last_transition.

Core PR #465 (xtrm-6hey0.1/.2) began publishing four more pane options at launch time:
`@agent_role`, `@agent_worktree`, `@agent_branch`, and `@agent_parent_pane`. The topology
projection does not read them, so every consumer that wants a pane's role, worktree, or
branch must re-query tmux per pane with `show-options` — N extra subprocesses to recover
data the topology walk already had in hand.

Found while building Core's aggregated topology projection (core xtrm-d1fod.3, audit
~/dev/11.md P2-05), which currently works around this with exactly that per-pane
show-options loop.

## SUCCESS

The `agent` object in xtrm.xtmux.topology.v1 carries role, worktree, branch and
parent_pane_id when the corresponding pane options are set, and consumers can drop their
per-pane show-options workaround.

## SCOPE

- The topology projection producer (bash picker `topology --json` path).
- The xtrm.xtmux.topology.v1 schema in @xtrm/contracts — additive optional fields, no
  version bump.
- Bridge relay is verbatim, so it should need no change; confirm.

## NON_GOALS

- Changing existing agent fields or their semantics. `task` keeps carrying
  `role:<name>`; `role` is additive and does not replace it.
- Making any of the new fields required. Bare (non-role) panes legitimately have none of
  them, and a required field would break every non-agent pane.
- Reading pane content. Unrelated surface.

## CONSTRAINTS

- Additive only: omit absent metadata rather than emitting empty strings, matching the
  schema's existing "omits absent agent metadata" rule.
- snake_case, consistent with the rest of the schema.
- Core must keep working against the current shape until this lands; the consumer-side
  workaround is a fallback, not a hard dependency.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] `xtmux topology --json` on a host with a live `--role` coordinator pane shows the
      four new fields populated.
- [ ] A bare pane shows the agent object without them (omitted, not empty).
- [ ] Schema validation passes for both cases.

## OUTPUT

The updated schema fields, sample topology output for a role pane and a bare pane, and a
note to core xtrm-d1fod.3 that the per-pane show-options workaround can be retired.

## REFERENCES

- Core PR #465 (c978d010) — publishes the pane options.
- Core epic xtrm-d1fod, child xtrm-d1fod.3 — the consumer.
- Audit ~/dev/11.md P2-05.
